How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your first use:



Read the warmer instructions and safety info.


If it uses a bulb, remove the plastic around the bulb first.


Wipe the top tray or place the silicone dish/liner on top.


Plug it in in a safe spot and turn it on.


Add wax melts: 2–3 bears for Mod/Signature warmers, 1–2 for Outlet/Mini Mod.


Set the timer if your warmer has one.



If you have any other questions or need more tips, just let me know—I'm happy to help!
